name: Card
summary: A bordered container that groups related content about one thing, such as a product, article or project.

anatomy.purpose: Bordered surface with consistent padding. Becomes a link or button only if the whole card is one action.
Image or illustration at the top or side. Needs alt text, or empty alt if decorative.
Small category label above the title.
One to two lines. Use a heading element at the right level.
Two to three lines of supporting text.
At most one primary and one secondary action.

variants.name: With media
variants.use: Products, articles and projects where an image helps.

variants.name: Clickable
variants.use: The whole card goes to one destination.

contentLimits.title: max 60 characters
contentLimits.actions: none inside; the card is the action

whenToUse: Showing a collection of similar items that people scan.
Grouping a small set of related facts.
whenNotToUse: Comparing many attributes: use a table.
One long text block: use plain page content.

accessibility.role: article or group (non-interactive); link when the whole card is clickable
keyboard: A clickable card is one Tab stop. Do not nest links or buttons inside it.
accessibility.focus: Show a focus ring around the whole card for clickable cards.
notes: Use the real heading level in the title.
Give the card link a name from the title, not Read more.
Text on image needs 4.5:1; prefer text below the image.
